steps.text: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C). Grease a 6-cup muffin pan.

Mix graham cracker crumbs, sugar, and melted butter together with a fork in a medium bowl until combined. Measure a rounded tablespoon of the mixture into the bottom of each muffin cup, pressing firmly. Bake in the pre-heated oven for 5 minutes, then remove to cool. Keep the oven on.
Beat cream cheese, sugar, lemon juice, lemon zest, and vanilla together until fluffy. Mix in the egg.

Pour the cream cheese mixture into the muffin cups, filling each until 3/4 full. Bake at 325 degrees F (165 degrees C) for 25 minutes. Cool completely in pan before removing. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

raw_recipe.headline: Easy Mini Cheesecakes
raw_recipe.description: This recipe makes 6 miniature cheesecakes in muffin cups. Excellent topped with fresh fruit or jelly.

review.reviewBody: I made a single batch of these to test the recipe, before making 2 dozen to take to an event. The first ones came out perfectly - at 25 minutes I wasn't sure they were done, but took them out anyway, figuring if they didn't set up I could bake the next ones longer. They tasted great after cooling and chilling, so I made the bigger batch the next day exactly the same - only difference was I used foil cupcake liners instead of paper - and they were full of cracks after 25 min! The next pan I checked at 15 min, and some of them were already starting to crack so I took them out. So beware, if you try the foil liners, they cook MUCH faster - but they do look a little nicer (the ones that didn't crack!) since the liner doesn't get all soggy looking. Oh, and I left out the lemon zest because I didn't have fresh lemons on hand, and didn't want too strong a lemon flavor. Yummy, thanks for a great recipe!

All I can say is WOW this was good! I wanted to make my husband a cheesecake for Father's Day but I didnt want to make a whole one. We are on a diet and we would eat a whole cheesecake if I made one. lol This was definitely the right recipie though! I tried this one because it has a graham cracker crust instead of the vanila wafer crust used in other similar recipies. They tasted just wonderful. It was easy to control portion size so we didnt go too crazy on the calories but we still got to eat some very tasty cheesecake. It was a very elegant presentation too. After they were cooled in the pan, I ran a thin knife around the edge and they came out easy. I served them graham cracker crust side up and drizzled on some sugar free strawberry glaze. My husband got his favorite desert to make him happy and we didnt have to completely wreck our diet to do it. I cant recomend this recipie enough if you want a delicious and authentic cheesecake taste in managable portion size.

great recipe! Super easy AND quick! I made some changes however - I used half the lemon juice, took out the lemon zest and doubled the vanilla extract. The lemon juice adds good acidity to the fattiness of the cream cheese, but adding 1 1/2 teaspoons of lemon juice makes it a bit too lemony :) I also baked them at 300 degrees rather than 325 degrees for about 16 minutes (I doubled the batch so it may be less for a single batch). Once they are done baking, turn off the oven and crack the oven door - leave the mini cheesecakes in the oven until the oven is done cooling (this is KEY to preventing cracks in the cheesecake!!) Overall this recipe is great. I used foil liners and sprayed the inside of them with canola oil spray so they peel off easier. I went simple with the topping and just sliced raw strawberries on top - looks great and adds great flavor!

Delicious recipe! I used all ingredients as stated, plus one TBLS sour cream. Baked ours in a toaster style air fryer, using a non-stick 12 mini-muffin pan (buttered) with "tiny cupcake" capacity 20 ml each cup. This recipe made 12 tiny-muffins which turned out perfectly after baking for about 15-16 minutes! About three bites per muffin. Definitely follow directions to NOT remove a muffin until they have cooled completely as stated in the recipe. I topped some of the muffins just before serving with slices of ripe strawberries. I prefer mine plain! Excellent recipe, so tasty! And helpful comments by others who who submitted their experience and results!

Yum! I did use low fat cream cheese, doubled the recipe because I had to use regular cupcake pan, and we had strawberries on hand I cut up tiny and added powdered sugar and leftover fresh lemon juice of half lemon. Way perfect for Mother’s Day! Thank you so much for sharing this tasty recipe. Try it with strawberries; will do that part over and over, with this recipe,

I used this recipe with a mini muffin pan. I tripled the mix for the crust and piped the cheesecake filling into 24 mini muffins. I baked the crust for 5 min like the recipe calls for and the cheesecakes for 20 min instead of 25. I wanted to make a 2-bite sized cheesecake and it worked out very well. Only problem is, I have to be careful not to eat 5 or 6 of them at a time. Yummy;)
So easy to make used a 6”inch daddyO pan& I added some freeze dried strawberries that I pulverized and it was soo good It tasted like strawberry shortcake crunch ice cream🍓🍰🍦💕

I love these. My niece also gets excited about them every time I make them. This is my go to recipe for potlucks, and recently even made them for a bake sale. The only change I make is that I leave out the lemon zest, I am afraid they will taste too much like lemon otherwise. I've never tried them with the zest, but I like it fine without so I just don't bother. When I bake them I also place the cupcake pan in a cookie sheet and add water (about 1-2 inches) - it helps prevent cracking. Just be careful with the hot water when taking out the pan (you can also just use a deeper pan). I also usually chop up some strawberries, sprinkle a bit of sugar on them, stir to coat, let them sit for about 10-15 minutes, and use the strawberries to top of the cupcakes. Delish!

Great! Exactly what I want in a cheesecake. In my opinion the lemon is very subtle and will be especially delicious when I top with raspberries. I doubled the crust because I like crust. I lined the cupcake pan with paper cupcake liners. I baked for 25 minutes, then turned off oven and left them in the oven with door propped open for another 30 minutes. I also placed a bowl of water on the bottom shelf because I heard that is how you keep them from cracking. Mine are perfect, so maybe that is the trick?

This is my “Go To” recipe for cheesecake. Whether I’m making minis or a full cheesecake. DELICIOUS and SO SIMPLE! For a full cheesecake, I just double the recipe, and it gives me a wonderful regular sized cheesecake. Today, I was craving something sweet and I had a little leftover batter in my freezer from the other day I made a full cheesecake, and I decided to make a couple of minis. I had just enough batter for two. After chilling, I topped them with my homemade strawberry preserves. I usually allow my cheesecake to chill overnight so the flavors can develop, but I couldn’t wait for these. They tasted delicious after “quick chilling” in the freezer. For the crust, I put in two small chocolate chip cookies from a pack of cookies I had. They worked great as a crust!

This recipe is delicious! The only changes I made were: 
1.) adding a tablespoon more butter to the crust and NOT baking it prior to adding the filling 
2.) I didn't use lemon zest & did use fresh squeezed lemon juice 
3.) I used a large ice cream scooper to fill each cupcake liner almost to the top 
4.) They needed to bake for 19 minutes & came out perfectly - no cracks & incredibly moist! 
5.) I added a dollop of cherry pie filling to the center of each. (Even with filling each so full, after baking, there was a slight indentation on top to hold it perfectly.) 
6.) I made two quadruple recipes (8 x's the recipe) and it made 7 dozen

I made this yesterday. The cream cheese filling was good but some of the crust were not bc I made a double batch. The butter should not be totally melted but only softened when mixed with the graham crackers. And it should first be refrigerated before taking out of the muffin pans. I also omitted the lemon as per others review. It was good.

Great recipe. The only variations are as such: I skipped the lemon part because I am not a fan of lemon. Since I used giant muffin tins, it was like four times the amount of ingredients to make my cheesecakes. This was fantastic!
Yummy, I stirred in tiny chocolate chips instead of lemon juice or zest.
They were really good but turned out extremely ugly.
Quick and easy recipe turned out great! Delicious!
Good , easy recipe. Was a bit disappointed at how light the cupcakes turned out, but taste was good. Think I will add more lemon zest for color.

I made this Mini Cheesecake today for my Easter dessert tomorrow. The only thing that turns out right. It was the cheesecake. The crust didn't turn out right. As the crust and the cream cheese mixture didn't stick together. I had to bake it the second time for 12 minutes. The first 25 minutes didn't worked. I must have done something wrong. I did follow the Instructions all the way.
Followed the recipe exactly as is. Delicious!!
